InvoiceOptions.syntax.doc: XML syntax of an XRechnung created by ``create_xrechnung``.

propertyDocs.CreateInvoiceRequest.options: Optional rendering and processing settings. Defaults apply when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.syntax: XML syntax produced by ``create_xrechnung``: UBL 2.1 (the default) or UN/CEFACT CII. Both declare the same specification identifier and pass the same BR-DE rule set. Ignored by ``create_zugferd``.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.language: Language of the rendered PDF template of ``create_zugferd``. English when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.brandColor: Primary brand colour in ``#RRGGBB`` form, applied to headings and accent backgrounds of the rendered PDF template. Body text is never recoloured.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.pdfUrl: Public http(s) URL of your own PDF to use as the visual layer of ``create_zugferd``. The generated XML is embedded into that PDF instead of the rendered template, so ``language``, ``brand_color``, ``logo_url`` and ``include_advanced_properties`` are ignored. Ignored by ``create_xrechnung``.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.logoUrl: Public URL of the seller's logo (PNG or JPEG, at most 2 MB and 4 megapixels), printed top left on the rendered PDF template and scaled to fit a 170 x 48 pt box.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.includeAdvancedProperties: When true, the rendered PDF gains an "Electronic invoice details" section listing technical properties that a classic layout does not show, such as the specification identifier, the business process, party identifiers and electronic addresses. Defaults to false.
